item.title: [Infraestrutura] CVE-2026-129171 - Nginx
item.description:
🚨 CVE-2026-129171 - Nginx
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: Nginx
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 9.8
Resumo:
NginxPulse 1.5.0 before 1.6.26 contains an unauthenticated sql injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to append SQL via the id and locationType parameters of /api/stats/:type. Attackers can close the quoted table-name identifier and use error-based output to read database contents, and read or write server files via PostgreSQL superuser functions.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-129171

item.title: [Segurança] New Mior and Skyfall Attacks Let Rogue Cloud Hosts Steal Secrets From AMD SEV-SNP VMs
item.description:
📰 New Mior and Skyfall Attacks Let Rogue Cloud Hosts Steal Secrets From AMD SEV-SNP VMs
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Two attacks made public this week allow a malicious host to read data inside AMD SEV-SNP-protected virtual machines (VMs), which are built to keep the server's operator out. One of them, Mior, can also modify a VM's memory and fake the signed report confirming which software it runs. Both need control of the server's hypervisor, and Mior also needs control of the server's BIOS.
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/new-mior-and-skyfall-attacks-let-rogue.html
